description: The user's SVG Lab cloud projects (My Projects). action new {name, imagery?} starts an empty project and switches to it (the current one is saved first); open {project_id} continues earlier work; list shows them, newest first; current gives the project in use and the link to hand the user; export {artboard, outline_text?, background?} returns one artboard as SVG with embedded fonts, without changing the document. Large exports return svg as a plain string slice with part, total_parts and export_id: fetch parts 2 through total_parts with {artboard, part, export_id} and concatenate svg in order without separators; pause saves and closes the server editor (hands your artboards back to the user) before a long think or when you are done; the next call reopens it.

background.description: export: a background colour for the exported copy.

export_id.description: export: the frozen export_id returned with part 1.

imagery.description: new: "drawn" when the brief rules out photos (place_image is then refused).

name.description: new: shown in My Projects, e.g. 'Coffee shop app'.

outline_text.description: export: outline the text in the exported copy.

part.description: export: numbered SVG part, starting at 1.

name: project
title: Manage projects
